snapshot_note: Snapshot for tests and as a starting point. SubmitReady re-reads the live guidelines on every run.

requirements.rule: Abstract at most 300 words, stand-alone, without references
Title, Abstract, Introduction, Materials and Methods, Results, Discussion and/or Conclusions; the order may vary
Highlights are optional: at most 5 bullets of 85 characters, between the title and the abstract
Figure captions at the end of the manuscript, not inside the figures
Figures at most 20 cm wide (2400 px at 300 dpi)
Tables in the manuscript file as editable text, notes below the table
Numbered citations in square brackets, per the journal's CSL style
Every reference is cited in the text and every citation is in the list; preprints marked [preprint], datasets marked [dataset]
Acknowledgements in a separate section before the references

requirements.quote: all necessary declarations have been made

requirements.rule: Single-column layout, as simple as possible
